- topojson-client 3.1.0 (ISC) - Copyright 2012-2019 Michael Bostock
- world-atlas 2.0.2 (ISC), derived from Natural Earth 1:110m (public domain)
- countries.json derived from i18n-iso-countries 7.14.0 (MIT)
- GeoIP: DB-IP Lite country and ASN databases (CC BY 4.0) https://db-ip.com - IP geolocation by DB-IP
